notes: Identity checked from supplied canonical text: title Neurocognitive correlates of liberalism and conservatism; David M Amodio, John T Jost, Sarah L Master and Cindy M Yee; doi:10.1038/nn1979; Nature Neuroscience, 2007. Two-page Brief Communications primary empirical report, including methods, results, figures and references; not an abstract-only parse. No local PDF was supplied, so no rendering was available. Canonical extraction uses ¼ for equals and o for less-than in running text; retain printed r and the same-test p bounds. The methods identify 43 EEG subjects, but do not explicitly state the final analytic participant count or exclusions for this particular correlation. The reported r(41) is retained as evidence, not used to derive N. Supplementary Methods are referenced but not supplied. No N arithmetic performed. The target is the explicitly labelled political-orientation/No-Go N2 association. The ERN association and the Go-response control correlations are separate tests. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
